audit.why: Content and packet agree (Brand x4, Swain L6, Brand, Brand). Brand's 1050-range Sear, 900-range Pillar and Blaze burn beat pre-6 Swain, and his Liandry's/Blackfire spike reclaims the lane after one item — all consistent with the content whys and spikes.
audit.corrected: Rows 0,1,2,3,5,6 moved to Brand with rewritten whys grounded in his kit; row 4 (Swain, level 6) already agreed. win[] already correct, so side+why edits only per the chart rule.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digits. Also worth noting: Brand Q, W, R are all projectiles/delayed zones — nothing in his kit stops Swain's E projectile, and neither side has a dash, so the lane is a pure skillshot exchange; Sear only stuns when the target is ablaze.
audit.why: Kit: Sear 8/7.5/7/6.5/6s, Pillar 10s rank 1, Conflagration 13s rank 1, Pyroclasm 100s. Swain E 12s rank 1.
audit.corrected: Real numbers written into breakdown.cooldowns; ablaze-condition kept as the tracked mechanic.

edits.before: Q-poke through the wave — the hand hurts more than people remember. Farm safely; your real spells arrive next.
edits.after: His 1050-range Sear and passive burn poke you off the wave before your Q matters. Take the safe CS and wait for levels.

edits.before: E online: the root that defines the lane. Land it and the Q follow-up chunks; miss it and you farm for fourteen seconds.
edits.after: E online, but stepping into 850 root range means eating Pillar plus burn. Hold it for his walk-up, not for even poke trades.

edits.before: W completes the setup: vision + slow from across the map. Root-into-W never misses, and the passive soul fragments heal you.
edits.after: Full combo online for both — his W-E-Q stun chain out-damages your setup and the burn undercuts your fragment heals. Respect it.

edits.before: Lost Chapter timing — Q-spam stops costing the lane. Poke the wave contact and pull every rooted target with the passive.
edits.after: Lost Chapter helps, but Pillar of Flame's 900 range still zones you off drain range. Farm with Q; all-in only off his whiff.

edits.before: Liandry's spike: the drain outpaces their damage in any extended fight. Force rivers, root the entry, ascend, profit.
edits.after: His Liandry's/Blackfire spike: burn poke zones you off waves and out-DPS's the drain. Wait for Rylai's and jungle help.

edits.before: Late Swain is the anti-team: flank-root their engage, ascend in their backline, and demonflare the clump that forms around you.
edits.after: Two items make him a backline burner who chunks you through Ascension — flank-root his position, never walk down the middle.

edits.before: - Brand Sear (Stun): matchup-defining — Q only stuns when you are ablaze — after eating W or E, the stun line is the dodge that matters. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget E Nevermove for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Brand Sear (Stun): Q only stuns while you are ablaze — after eating W or E, dodging the 8s-cooldown stun line is what matters. - Pillar is 10s and Conflagration 13s at rank 1: both down means a long window where he cannot chain a stun on you.

edits.before: E his step-up, passive-pull the root for the chunk + heal, Q the retreat — every landed root is a won trade with a health refund attached.
edits.after: Cast R before his combo lands, not after — the drain ticks while his burn does, and Pyroclasm's bounces feed a healing Swain, not a dying one.

edits.before: Brawling pre-6 like the demon is already online — Swain without R is a slow mage with a dream and a root on cooldown.
edits.after: A whiffed Nevermove is 12 seconds where his 1050-range Sear line comes free — throw it at his step-up, never at hopeful range.

notes: Calibration note honoured: Brand's R is Pyroclasm (not 'Ares of Blaze'); current text already uses correct names.
